V3_kill_C_program_and_honest_statement.statement: KILL-C IS THE MOST ARMED: the decayed-exponent detection is ALREADY powered on the 55 HI dwarfs (deep tail to g_N = 0.036 a0; power 0.92 at N = 55 for a 0.4-vs-0.5 exponent at 3 sig), the z~2.5 funnel needs N = 4 for a 5-sig verdict at the 0.33-dex separation (verdict ~2027-2028), the MIGHTEE re-analysis decides the standing 5.2-sig DE rejection NOW (a0_MIGHTEE 1.690e-10-1.843e-10), and Gaia DR4 fires the 30.7-sig ridge verdict on 2026-12-02.  HONEST STATEMENT: the unification's three kill tests ARE each a runnable observing program with stated power, exposure, and date -- KILL-A re-reduction today (power 0.8 at N = 24 both-T systems, single-pair threshold 0.326 dex); KILL-B archival stack today + XRISM width verdict ~2027-2028 (1 Ms per frozen target); KILL-C MIGHTEE now, DR4 2026-12-02, JWST z~2.5 ~2027-2028 (N = 4 for 5 sig). The unification remains LIVE because all three kill conditions are registered, instrumented, and dated.
